fields.description: Issue includes a "NOTEBOOK" column by Wen R. Phillips commenting on the American Legion convention in Miami and criticizing price increases in rents, food, and services during the event. Coverage also includes local political notes (including mention of John Levi for mayor in an upcoming Miami Beach election), extensive horse-racing commentary and tips (including discussion of trainer Clay Sutphin and Florida racing commission testing), entertainment and nightlife listings/advertising, and radio program schedules for Miami stations.
